summary: Automations: a built-in Secret connector on the Integrations page (create, rename, rotate, delete; values behind an OpenBao-ready storage port, the first adapter the connections' encrypted store) resolved by Code and HTTP nodes before the application's resolver, with Secrets.Manage / Secrets.Use permissions; CodeAccessor for the SDK connectors — HTTP/API (base URL and a fetch with injected auth), Telegram bot, Email (SMTP) and AI/LLM — with typed refusals for disabled or broken connections.
